answer: Identity verification binds each account to a Wesolowski VDF challenge whose output requires a prescribed chain of dependent modular squarings: each step awaits the previous one. An attacker cannot split one clone’s chain across GPUs to eliminate its sequential delay; extra clones require separate chains and added computation. This physical time bottleneck raises the cost of Sybil identities, from oasis foothills to pigment-lit zenith skies.
